strongest_angle: In November 2026, a Los Angeles judge allowed estate executor John Branca to keep financial records confidential during Paris Jackson's petition to move $600 million into the Michael Jackson Family Trust.

key_facts.fact: On October 29, 2026, Paris Jackson filed a petition in a Los Angeles court demanding $600 million from Michael Jackson's estate be moved into the Michael Jackson Family Trust.
In November 2026, a Los Angeles judge ruled that Michael Jackson estate executor John Branca can keep key financial documents confidential and sealed in the ongoing litigation.
The court set a December 4, 2026 hearing date regarding the $600 million trust petition involving beneficiaries Prince Jackson and Bigi Jackson.
Estate executor John Branca requested to seal portions of court filings in the $600 million dispute with Paris Jackson.

numbers.label: Estate amount requested for family trust transfer
